headline: Rights are fundamental entitlements—what every person deserves simply by being human
universal_truth: Some things are owed to every person regardless of status; recognizing this shapes how we treat each other
fun_facts: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights was adopted by the UN in 1948
Rights often emerged from historical struggles against oppression
The concept of rights attempts to protect the vulnerable from the powerful
discussion_questions: What do you believe every person deserves?
How do rights differ from privileges?
What rights do you take for granted that others lack?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Some things you deserve just because you're human. Not because you earned them, not because someone grants them—because you exist. Rights are the recognition that every person has inherent worth and deserves certain treatment.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Rights are contested. Who decides what people deserve? What gives rights their force?

options.text: Rights are moral claims based on human dignity—recognizing that every person has inherent worth that demands certain treatment; they exist whether or not they're respected
options.response: Yes. Rights aren't given by governments—they're recognized by them. The claim that every human deserves certain treatment is foundational to how we should relate to each other.
Laws can protect rights, but rights precede laws—that's why we say rights can be violated...

q1.title: Rights vs Privileges
q1.script: Rights are inherent; privileges are granted. Rights can't be taken away without injustice; privileges can be withdrawn. Knowing the difference matters for what we fight to protect.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Rights vs Privileges"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Rights and Responsibilities
q2.script: Rights imply responsibilities. Your right to speak comes with responsibility for your words. Rights exist in relationship—respecting others' rights is the other side of claiming your own.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Protecting the Vulnerable
q3.script: Rights protect the vulnerable from the powerful. When you're powerful, you don't need rights—you just take what you want. Rights matter most for those who can't protect themselves.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Some things are owed to every person regardless of status. Recognizing this shapes how we treat each other. Honor everyone's inherent worth.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 330! Tomorrow, we'll explore what you owe others—responsibilities. Until then, consider what you believe everyone deserves.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Rights Reflection - What Does Everyone Deserve?
growTrack.learning_objective: Examine beliefs about fundamental human rights
growTrack.activity: What do you believe every person deserves—regardless of their behavior, status, or identity? How does recognizing these rights affect how you treat people? What rights do you have that others lack?
